units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 3:6">Targ. Cant. III, 6</cite>; a. e., v. <cite ref="H01343"><he>חִסְדּוּתָא</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 110b:5">Snh. 110ᵇ</cite> <he>שַׁבְקָהּ ר״ע לחֲסִידוּתֵיה</he> R. Ak. has abandonned his (usual) kindness, i.e. his harsh opinion does not agree with the liberality shown elsewhere.
